title: Cultural Arts Funding and Equity Plans
summary:
*   A public hearing was scheduled to consider amending the policy for major cultural arts facilities, indicating a review of how art institutions are supported.
*   A worksession was held to discuss the Affirmative Action Plan Task Force, signaling ongoing efforts to develop equity initiatives.
*   This special meeting was brief and focused, primarily addressing these two significant policy areas.
